| Learn D | Modeling Decimal Subtracting
To evaluate : 0.52 - 0.14

1, Shade a model to represent the minuend (0.52).

2.Add X’s to represent the subtrahend (0.14).

3.Count the shaded squares without (X] which is the difference.
